summary: CBIZ, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing it inadvertently purchased and delivered up to 481,049 shares under its 2007 ESPP from October 16, 2023 to April 15, 2026, exceeding the number registered on Form S-8. The board approved a voluntary rescission offer on July 28, 2026, giving eligible participants the option to sell shares back at the discounted ESPP price (15% discount) plus statutory interest, or receive compensation for prior losses. Maximum aggregate payments could reach approximately $20.2 million, calculated as of June 30, 2026. The company believes the error and rescission offer will not materially impact operations, financial condition, or liquidity. Watch for participant election rates and any regulatory scrutiny from the SEC.
